learning_outcomes.text: Understanding the fundamentals of antenna theory.
Understanding the characteristic properties of various types of antennas.
Antenna analyses according to different propagation conditions.
Design, analysis, and computer modeling of different types of antennas.
Solving engineering problems and antenna engineering skills.

syllabus_topics: Applied explanation and example antenna design using antenna design software
Technological development of antennas, antenna analysis and concepts in electromagnetic theory
Basic antenna parameters: gain, directivity, efficiency
Basic antenna parameters: matching coefficient, Friis equation
Midterm exam solution and antenna applications
Propagation in different environmental conditions, factors affecting the propagation of electromagnetic waves
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
